MeetGeek has a free tier plus Pro, Business, and custom-priced Enterprise plans. The pricing page currently lists **Pro at $9.99 per user/month** and **Business at $17 per user/month**; annual billing can save up to 40%.[1]

## Plans at a glance

| Plan | Price | Transcription allowance | Storage | Best fit |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Basic | Free forever | 3 hours/month | Transcripts: 3 months; audio: 1 month | Occasional use or trying it out |
| Pro | $9.99/user/month | 20 hours/month | Transcripts: 1 year; audio: 6 months | Regular individual users and automation workflows |
| Business | $17/user/month | Unlimited | Unlimited transcripts; video: 12 months | Frequent meeting users and collaborating teams |
| Enterprise | Contact sales | Unlimited | Unlimited transcripts; custom video retention | Organizations needing governance, SSO/SCIM, custom retention, and dedicated support |

*Pricing shown is the per-user monthly figure displayed on MeetGeek’s pricing page; verify the billing toggle and checkout total before purchasing.*[1]

## What changes by tier

- **Basic** includes recording for Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and other supported platforms; transcription in 100+ languages; unlimited AI summaries; search/AI chat; uploads; mobile apps; and API/MCP access. Its main constraints are the 3-hour monthly transcription limit and shorter retention.[1]
- **Pro** adds meeting templates and automatic meeting-type detection, unlimited integrations, Zapier/Make/n8n, AI agents and workflows, exports, flexible sharing, and basic admin user management. It also includes a 14-day paid-feature trial.[1]
- **Business** adds HD video recording, shared team/group spaces, automatic team sharing, team analytics, comments, branding/custom summaries, private-by-default meetings, recording-consent notifications, and unlimited AI chat/workflows.[1]
- **Enterprise** adds organization-wide controls, SSO and SCIM, zero/custom retention policies, on-premise storage options, custom avatars/voice agents, an account manager, and early access to specialized AI models.[1]

## Cost examples

At the listed monthly rates:

| Seats | Pro | Business |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | $9.99/month | $17/month |
| 5 | $49.95/month | $85/month |
| 10 | $99.90/month | $170/month |
| 25 | $249.75/month | $425/month |

MeetGeek says teams can mix Basic, Pro, Business, and Enterprise seats within one workspace, so not every employee necessarily needs the same paid tier.[1]

## Practical choice

- Choose **Basic** if you have only a few meetings a month and mainly need transcripts and summaries.
- Choose **Pro** if 20 hours per month covers you and you want integrations, templates, and automated follow-up workflows.
- Choose **Business** if you record heavily, need video retention, or want team-wide sharing and analytics.
- Request an **Enterprise** quote if compliance, identity provisioning, data-retention controls, or deployment requirements are decisive.

The official pricing page also advertises special pricing for eligible startups, nonprofits, and educational institutions, though the exact eligibility and discount amount should be confirmed directly with MeetGeek.[1]

Pipedrive’s current CRM plans range from **$14 to $79 per user/month when billed annually**, or **$24 to $99 per user/month on monthly billing**. There is no permanent free tier, but it offers a 14-day trial without requiring a credit card.[1][2]

## Plan prices

| Plan | Annual billing | Monthly billing | Best fit |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Lite | $14/user/month | $24/user/month | Individuals and small teams needing core pipeline, contact, and activity management |
| Growth | $39/user/month | $49/user/month | Growing sales teams that need email sync, tracking, and workflow automation |
| Premium | $59/user/month | $79/user/month | Teams needing more advanced lead management, collaboration, forecasting, and customization |
| Ultimate | $79/user/month | $99/user/month | Organizations needing higher limits, stronger governance/security, and premium support |

These are per-seat prices, so multiply the monthly rate by the number of paid users. Pipedrive revised its packaging in 2025, replacing older plan names such as Essential, Advanced, Professional, Power, and Enterprise with Lite, Growth, Premium, and Ultimate.[1][2]

## Quick cost examples

| Team size | Lite, annual billing | Growth, annual billing | Premium, annual billing |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 3 users | $42/month | $117/month | $177/month |
| 10 users | $140/month | $390/month | $590/month |
| 25 users | $350/month | $975/month | $1,475/month |

For example, a 10-person sales team on Premium would pay about **$590/month** on annual billing, or **$790/month** if paying month to month.

## What to choose

- Choose **Lite** if you primarily want a straightforward visual sales pipeline and basic CRM.
- Choose **Growth** if salespeople need connected email, automated follow-ups, and more repeatable processes.
- Choose **Premium** if you need more sophisticated lead handling, revenue forecasting, and team coordination.
- Choose **Ultimate** if security controls, account governance, support, and maximum platform limits matter most.

## Watch for extras

The base seat price may not cover every capability your team wants. Pipedrive sells or bundles certain functionality differently by plan, and potential extra costs can include lead-generation tools, campaign/email-marketing features, project management, document-signing integrations, calling, and third-party app integrations. Confirm the included limits and add-ons on Pipedrive’s [official pricing page](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing) before purchasing.[3]
